scientific_scope_status: Source-reported global theorem candidate: distinct canonical-sign nonidentity Pauli strings P_a on n qubits, support size <=k and candidate incidence max_i #{a:i in supp P_a}<=Delta (including zero-coefficient candidates), H(h)=sum h_a P_a with max_i sum_(a:i in supp P_a)|h_a|<=g, beta>0 and an unrestricted full-rank Gibbs state rho_h. For every real u, A=sum u_aP_a and A_c=A-Tr(rho A)I, the manuscript proposes centered KMS norm squared >=c||u||_2^2 and therefore BKM covariance >=c||u||_2^2, c=exp[-C_(k,Delta)(1+beta g)^2]. C is finite/constructive, independent of n,m, signs, gaps and mixing, but potentially extremely conservative. No commutation, frustration exclusion, high temperature or correlation-decay assumption is made. This is an unreviewed derivation with unknown independent correctness/priority, not a validated new physical law or end-to-end learning advantage.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Infer a global information-matrix floor from positive local variances alone
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: Termwise local bounds do not control off-diagonal cancellation. The source supplies an additional coefficient-l2 tail bound and localized-adjoint image lemma, still requiring independent reconstruction.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Replace bounded candidate incidence by bounded weighted interaction strength
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: A two-local classical star with nonzero lambda/N couplings has uniformly bounded incident strength but a coefficient direction of variance O(1/N) and nonvanishing coefficient l2 norm. Its center degree grows; it does not refute the bounded-incidence claim.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Treat the auxiliary G as a rapidly mixing physical Gibbs sampler
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: The covariance proof needs exact KMS self-adjointness/localizability, not complete positivity or rapid mixing. Its image bound is scoped to the bounded-incidence interaction space, not all operators.

reported_failed_attempts.attempt: Promote conditioning or copy bounds to cheap reconstruction or fixed-sector information
reported_failed_attempts.failure_scope: Dense gradients can cost exponentially in n and Gibbs copies require acquisition. Fixed-charge sectors have exact null directions and lie outside the unrestricted full-rank theorem. RMS error is not a per-coefficient l-infinity guarantee.
